title: A verify record: <git-common-dir>/vextrus/verify-<tree>.json
description: Contract (PR f0) for the file `uv run python -m scripts.verify` (the `verify` skill, PR f4) writes for one tree, and the guard's READY push gate (`.claude/hooks/guard.mjs`, PR f2), `.claude/hooks/stop-gate.mjs` (PR f6) and `scripts/factory/watch.py` (PR f3) read (docs/specs/factory.md 2.2 'Builder's finish', 3.4 'verify', 3.6). WHERE: `$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/vextrus/verify-<tree>.json`, shared by every worktree of the clone and never committed; `<tree>` is the 40-hex tree id that `git write-tree` printed for the staged index when `verify` ran. WRITE: `verify` writes it once, after every check has run, atomically (temp file then rename), and overwrites an older record for the same tree. It prints the trailer `Factory-Verify: <tree> ok` (trailers.md) only when `ok` is true. READ: the guard's READY push gate computes `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` of the head being pushed and passes only when `verify-<that tree>.json` exists, parses, has `schema_version` 1, has a non-empty `checks` array and every element's `exit_code` is 0. It reads `checks[].exit_code` and nothing else; `ok` is for humans and the trailer, and `verify` writes it as exactly 'every exit_code is 0'. A missing, unparsable, empty or failing record refuses the push. `exit_code` is the check's verdict, not always the command's: where every failing test of the command is listed in `.github/flaky.txt` the check is recorded with `exit_code` 0, `flakes` naming those tests and `raw_exit_code` holding the command's own code; any failure not listed keeps the command's code in both fields.

tree.description: The tree id of the staged index (`git write-tree`) the checks ran on. Equal to the file name's <tree> and to the tree of the commit made from that index.

ok.description: True only when every check's exit_code is 0.

checks.description: One element per check `verify` ran for the changed paths, in run order (the fast check per module, spec 3.4). A check that was skipped because no changed path maps to it is not listed.

name.description: A short id: pytest, ruff, ruff-format, mypy, lint-imports, openapi-export, api-types, typecheck, lint, messages-check, web-test, node-test, plugin-validate, plugin-test, ...

command.description: The command line as run (public words only; never a key).

exit_code.description: The check's verdict: 0 passed. The only field the guard reads.

raw_exit_code.description: The command's own exit code. Differs from exit_code only when the command failed on listed flakes alone.

flakes.description: Test ids from .github/flaky.txt that failed in this run and were recorded as flakes, not failures. [] when none.

root_only.description: Test lines from .github/flaky-root.txt that failed in this run, which ran as root (uid 0), and were recorded as root-only, not failures (exit_code 0, raw_exit_code the command's own). Optional; [] or absent when none.

output_file.description: The file holding the command's output (CLAUDE.md: every suite run's output is kept in a file), a path relative to the repository root; the file is never committed.
